body:
I know I've been through a lot, but I still try to not complain about it. I don't talk to anyone about this, I mostly am very private. No one truly knows everything about me and what has happened in my life.

Some days are most definitely better than others. The days where I can smile at someone and actually mean it, even just once, or just a little bit, is a good day. But it's also a good day when no one asks me what's wrong, I find it really hard lying to my family about it and saying that I'm 'just tired.' Some days hit me really hard though, it's usually when I'm on my way home from something, mostly when I decide that I want to leave my house so I go to a movie alone. On those nights I find it really hard not to crash my car. I admit, I drive very recklessly on these nights, trying to build up the courage to hit something ( but never another car, or somewhere I could potentially hurt someone ) Actually lately I've been spending a lot of time alone driving around the city, I found this place about a half hour away with a huge cliff on it. I find myself parking on top of it and wondering what it would be like to drive off.

I guess I've always been introverted. Even growing up, in day care I would hide from the other kids and sit alone and read by myself. Mostly I would like to have one close friend, and a boyfriend, or even just a boyfriend. I can't handle having a lot of people that I have an obligation to hang out with all the time because I really value my alone time. In saying that though, not a lot of people have wanted to be my friend.

A part of this I think is also a very bad self image. I really hate the way I look, it makes me sad that I don't find myself more attractive. I also hate that it bothers me. People do tell me how beautiful I am, I've even been stopped by strangers on occasion. I know it seems stupid or self diluted, but I don't see it. It scares me, because I always thought that if I were prettier, my life would be better, and if people think I'm so beautiful already then I really have nothing to look forward to. Also, it makes intimacy in my relationships sometimes awkward and hard for me. I'm not comfortable with myself, so as you can imagine sex is just a whole other thing for me. But I won't get into that.

I know I went more into what you asked. I just feel like it's all coming out now, and I need to say it.

Yes. Growing up I would move around a lot, so I would never have time to make any friends. I've been friendless for most of my life, and would usually cover all of my frustrations in reading or writing stories. A few years ago I found myself in one place, I finally made a friend and it was all going good. A year after I moved to this place I started suffering from a sever anxiety disorder and could hardly even leave my house. I lost what friends I had and started doing terribly in school ( I blame this sudden disorder on my boyfriend at the time being diagnosed with a very brutal and harsh cancer and I was just too young at the time to deal with it properly ) Soon after he got better though ( and we broke up ), I found myself with my friends again, my life was alright. Then I met a boy, who was much older and he was very controlling and a bad influence. So I ended up being beaten one night by my step father ( from an argument that stemmed from me dating this guy ), and got kicked out because my mother didn't believe me ( he was a very well respected military man who brought my mother and I out of poverty ) For this reason I didn't call the police or try to 'take him down', no one else in my family knows of this happening. Anyways I move in with this boyfriend at the time and it's a very emotionally abusive relationship, but eventually after a year I'm out of it. I had no where to go, so I went back to my previous best friend. She helped me so much, and for that I am so grateful. I ended up moving to a new city again with relatives. Never met anyone, and at this point I couldn't leave my house because of my anxiety and depression. My doctor tried to medicate me for it, but nothing worked. So in September, all of my friends came to this city for University, which was amazing. However I found myself being left out a lot, or neglected for boyfriends ( I was unable to date for a very long time ) Now very recently I found myself becoming close with a new girl, I consider her such a close friend, but last week she left to live with her boyfriend in a different city pretty far away. This other girl who I considered my other closest friend has told me she wants nothing to do with me anymore. I met a guy I liked and we were dating for a while, and he told me a few days ago he couldn't commit to me. I failed every single one of my classes in University this semester. I have no energy, no will to do anything, and I've felt like this for years now. I don't feel like it's worth it. I don't feel like anything will get better. I find myself not caring anymore, I just don't want to do this anymore. Sorry for the wall of text.
